marine.title: Forecast for Tonight and Wednesday.
marine.text:
Wind west 15 knots veering to northwest 20 late overnight. Wind
northwest 20 Wednesday. Snow or freezing rain changing to scattered flurries near
midnight and ending Wednesday afternoon. Visibility 1 mile or less in
precipitation. Temperatures zero falling to minus 8 Wednesday
evening. Freezing spray beginning Wednesday morning. <br/>

marine.title: Waves for Tonight and Wednesday.
marine.text:
Seas 1 metre or less building to 1 to 2 Wednesday
morning.<br/>
